question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 4' **i.e. **'Benefit'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the context of this sentence, the word** "benefit"** best fits the blank as it refers to something that promotes or enhances well-being.
 
• **"Benefit" **here signifies the positive aspect or advantage of traveling, which is said to improve well-being.

Therefore, the** correct sentence** is: *Improving your well-being is considered to be the fundamental **benefit** of travelling. Travelling helps to decrease the risks of heart disease and anxiety (2) ________ developing our brain health. There have been studies proving that travel can have a positive impact on our heart (3) ________. The health benefit of travelling is that when you travel to new surroundings you (4) ________ a restart button to your body and mind. This brings in fresh energy when you get back to your normal (5) ________ activities.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's consider the other options:
 
 
• **"Rancidity"** refers to the state of being rancid; rankness or disagreeable odor or taste, which doesn't make sense in this context.
 
• **"Sanctity"** refers to the state or quality of being holy, sacred, or saintly, which also doesn't fit into the context of the sentence.
 
• **"Sanity"** refers to the ability to think and behave in a normal and rational manner; sound mental health, which is not the best fit in the context of this sentence.
